column1: # CaliciNet monthly norovirus outbreak genotype percentages, United States.
# Source: Barclay L, Vinje J. Increasing Predominance of Norovirus GII.17 over GII.4,
# United States, 2022-2025. Emerg Infect Dis 31(7), 2025. Figure 2.
# Values are TRANSCRIBED from the data table printed beneath Figure 2, not digitised from
# the plotted bars, so they are exact to the printed integer percent.
# Figure 2 reports only GII.4 and GII.17 against a grey "Total" envelope of all outbreaks.
# The two named percentages do not sum to 100, so the remainder is other genotypes; it is
# derived here as other_pct = 100 - gii4_pct - gii17_pct rather than being read off.
# Season denominators printed on the figure: 2022-23 N=372, 2023-24 N=321, 2024-25 N=354
#  - Denominator is OUTBREAKS typed by CaliciNet, not read pairs. Comparison with CASPER
#    is of composition and temporal pattern, not of the same quantity.
#  - Monthly outbreak totals are small in summer months (the grey envelope approaches
#    zero), so percentages in Jun-Sep rest on very few outbreaks and are noisy.
#  - Season totals are printed; per-month totals are not, so monthly percentages cannot be
#    weighted by their denominator from the published figure alone.
